newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks edge up, ignore interest rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks edge up, ignore interest rate cuts.

text.p: BOGOTA, May 7 Reuter - Colombian stocks edged up slightly but were apparently unaffected by the central bank's decision to cut interest rates.

Bogota's IBB .IBB index ended up 0.27 percent to 1,166.07 amid a 5.1 billion peso volume. Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG general price index gained 0.2 percent to close at 17,669.75 amid a 3.3 billion peso volume.
"The interest rate cut was not reflected in the markets at all. We were expecting more aggressive measures," one Bogota broker said.
